observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: indoor arena stage with large audience surrounding it under bright stage lights
observation.dancers: mixed group of male traditional dancers and male breakdancers
observation.formation_and_space: group performs on a circular stage, shifting between group formations and individual solos
observation.posture: upright during footwork, bending forward or dropping to the floor for floor work and acrobatics
observation.footwork: fast rhythmic stepping, kicks, and jumps alternating with breakdancing footwork like foot sweeps and freezes
observation.arms_and_hands: arms swing and extend for balance; dancers in traditional costume hold metal shears in their hands
observation.hips_and_torso: torso bends and twists during acrobatics and floor work
observation.levels_jumps_turns: frequent level changes including standing, crouching, floor spins, back flips, headspins, and jumps
observation.costume_and_props: traditional dancers wear ornate colorful tunics, patterned trousers, hats, and hold large scissors/shears; breakdancers wear casual street clothes like t-shirts, jeans, and sneakers
observation.cannot_infer: exact footwork speed and weight distribution details are difficult to discern due to fast camera cuts and stage lighting glare

signature_moments.what: traditional dancers rapidly stepping in place while clicking shears in each hand
breakdancer performing floor spins and freezes on the circular stage
traditional dancer performing floor spins on their back while holding shears
